name: Transaction Operation Type 6 Code
definition: Specifies the transaction operation action type.

REUU.name: Collateral Reuse Update
REUU.definition: Update in the reuse of collateral, the reinvestment of cash or the margin lending funding sources.

CORR.name: Correction
CORR.definition: Transaction corrects errors in a previously sent transaction.

VALU.name: Valuation Update
VALU.definition: Update of a contract valuation or collateral.

POSC.name: Position Component
POSC.definition: Contract to be reported as a new trade and included in a separate position report on the same day.

MODI.name: Modification
MODI.definition: Transaction modifies in a previously sent transaction.

MARU.name: Margin Update
MARU.definition: Specifies a dedicated report to provide changes in initial and variation margin that a reporting counterparty posts with regards to CCP-cleared SFTs.

EROR.name: Error
EROR.definition: Cancellation of a wrongly submitted entire report in case the contract never came into existence or was not subject to regulatory reporting requirements but was reported to a regulatory authority by mistake, in which case, it will be identified as ‘error’.
